The current Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary PvP season is coming to an end.

Have a good fight to the finish!

posts.name: TIXX
posts.cooked:
Just for visibility rank one title is calculating at top 0.08% of players instead of 0.1% of players as intended.

Currently in NA 2V2 for example, we can determine the player pool to be roughly 80,000 based on glad and duelist slots. 80000 x 0.005 =400, the number of glad slots. 80000 x 0.03=2400, the number of duelist slots. However, if we take 80000*0.001 we should get 80 slots… but we look at ladder and it’s 64 (current number of r1 slots) which means it’s calculating at 0.08%.

All numbers can be verified via sites that pull the API data, like ironforge pro or xunamate.

This is true across all regions and brackets. It’s broken. Please fix.

Effectively there are significantly fewer rank-1 slots than there really should be.
